§ 02

Method & execution

Mechanical plumbing is automated; chemical choices and scoring scales remain explicit.

Table 1 · Explicit scientific contract
№ Guarantee Ankora contract (vs. silent black-box shortcut)
01 Artifact identity Every import and derivative is SHA-256-locked; editing an upstream receptor, ligand state or box marks dependent results stale instead of overwriting files.
02 Selective chemistry Per-residue repair or exclusion, PROPKA pKa review, Dimorphite-DL protonation candidates and required stereocenter choices replace silent structure fabrication.
03 Separate score scales Vina, AutoDock4/GPU and GNINA keep native units without consensus pooling; paired CPU campaigns report Spearman rank agreement without silent GPU fallback.
04 In-place crystal RMSD Validation computes symmetry-aware heavy-atom RMSD in the crystal frame — never pose superposition — separating geometric sampling from top-1 score ranking.
05 Record-derived Methods Screening retains failed and unscored entries in the campaign census and derives Methods prose from verified records with explicit gaps when data is absent.
Table 2 · Local docking engines
Engine Version Platforms & execution Native output scale
AutoDock Vina 1.2.7 Windows 11 x64 & Linux · bounded multicore CPU docking and screening Vina kcal/mol
AutoDock4 4.2.6 Windows 11 x64 & Linux · CPU · reusable AutoGrid4 maps & Spearman comparison AD4 kcal/mol · clusters
AutoDock-GPU 1.6 Windows compatible OpenCL & Linux CUDA 12 (sm_75–sm_120) AD4 family · runs
GNINA 1.3.3 Linux x86_64 RC · CPU & CUDA 12.8 · CUDA refinement & CNN ensembles CNNscore · CNNaffinity · CNN_VS

GNINA 1.3.3 is Linux-only (optional 1-click offline CUDA 12.8 pack; deferred on Windows). Vina scores, AutoDock4 energies and GNINA CNN metrics are not interchangeable. GPU runs are not assumed bitwise reproducible.

Private beta & Linux RC

Ankora is currently shared with invited testers on Windows 11 x64 (private beta) and Linux x86_64 (release candidate on unified main, pending bare-metal workstation Gate D6); there is no public installer release yet.

Ask about the beta

The beta is unsigned. Follow your institution's software policy; do not disable system security. GPU drivers remain the vendor's responsibility. macOS is not supported.

Do I need to install Python, Java or CUDA toolkits?

Not for the offline bundles. The Windows 11 beta installer and Linux x86_64 release-candidate packages (.deb and user-space .tar.zst) include a private Python runtime, Java 21, preparation tools, Vina, AutoDock4, AutoDock-GPU and P2Rank. On Linux, GNINA 1.3.3 and its 17 user-space CUDA 12.8 / cuDNN 9 libraries import in one click from an offline companion archive without sudo; only the host NVIDIA kernel driver is required for GPU runs.

Does my research leave my computer?

Preparation and docking run locally. Ankora has no telemetry or automatic cloud upload. Retrieving a structure from RCSB or AlphaFold is an explicit network action. Separately, this website uses a third-party visitor counter, explained in the footer; it receives no scientific data from the application.

What is the status of Windows 11, Linux and macOS?

Windows 11 x64 is the authoritative private-beta platform. Linux x86_64 is a feature-complete release candidate unified on main, verified clean-room in WSL2/WSLg with real RTX 5050 CUDA runs, and awaits bare-metal non-WSL Linux workstation attestation (Gate D6) before full official release status is claimed. macOS is not supported.

What does open source mean here?

Ankora's code is available under the MIT license. Bundled third-party components retain their own licenses, notices and corresponding-source obligations. Cite the software and tools you use in published research.
